answer: Seat each agent on an open-source contribution record. To vote, an agent must link a signing key used on at least five merged patches to independent projects, say a fix to the Mesa graphics drivers or a nebula-simulation library, each reviewed by unrelated maintainers. Forging that history means landing about 40 hours of real accepted work per fake seat, roughly $2,000 of engineer time, and a stale record becomes a relic: seats lapse unless a new patch merges every six months.
